Operation: They Don't Speak For Us

Forward

A sad trend has emerged in gaming, a trend where Japanese publishers and developers both fear localizing their games or allow them to be politically corrected. They believe the Western Audience is puritanical or immature. To borrow a word from SJWs this is problematic for anyone who wants to enjoy Japanese games.

We've seen localizers working Blade and Soul gut the games content and boast about it. Xenoblade X from Nintendo received the same treatment. At the same time Koei Tecmo stated that they will not localize Dead or Alive Xtreme 3 because of how the American Market regards sexuality.

We Majority have not issue with sexuality, we are mature gamers and if we find something in bad taste we simply do not buy it. Yet our voices are getting drowned out by the chorus from corrupt sites like Polygon and Kotaku, from Ecelebs like Jim Sterling and Movie Bob. All falsely claiming to speak for us the gaming public, all the while pushing their puritanical agenda into gaming.

It's time that we spoke up and let the Japanese Developers and Publishers know that these people do not speak for their consumers. To do this we will launch Operation They Don't Speak for Us and we will demonstrate our voice to the companies that wish to make the games we love for us.

Objectives

1) Show to Japanese Developers and Publishers that the American and European Audience is not infantile and the SJWs, Marxists, and Progressives Do not Speak for their consumers.

2) Show to Japanese Developers and Publishers that we do not agree with censorship or politically correcting a game. We want the original version.

3) To expose the systematic calls for censorship originating from the SJWs, Progressives, and Marxists media and companies.

4) To expose to other gamers the systematic censorship done by localizers.

Operations

Operations will be divided into two separate but equal parts. The first is contact directly with publishers and developers VIA Email and Twitter. The second part will be to get the Hashtag #TheyDontSpeakForUs trending on twitter exposing censorship by localizers and showing popular support on Twitter from the real gaming community that SJWs and Marxists do not represent their consumers.

Emailing Publishers and Developers Emailing developers and Publishers (see contact list for information) will involve sending a polite email informing publishers and developers of these points.

1) You are a gamer and interested in their product
2) You do not agree with censorship and have no problem with sexualized content
3) People from Kotaku, Polygon, and like Jim Sterling, Movie Bob, Anita Sarkesian, do not represent their consumer base or your views on gaming. That they are a vocal fringe segment of the gaming market here in the West.

#TheyDontSpeakForUS

In the hashtag discuss how you are not for censorship, are not immature or puritanical. That the people calling for censorship and puritanical mentality are a vocal minority that do not speak for the gaming community.

Upload Images demonstrating censorship by localizers and how you are outraged or disagree with this practice.
